js: document.getElementById('hud').hidden=true; const sb=window.sandbox; const r=sb.rider; sb.P.stormFrequency=0; sb.P.fogDistance=15000; sb.world.weather.spawnStorm(r.pos.x+3000, r.pos.z+3000, sb.skyTime-170, {D:400, I:2}); sb.camOverride=(c,rr)=>{c.position.set(rr.pos.x-1500,2600,rr.pos.z-1500);c.up.set(0,1,0);c.lookAt(rr.pos.x+2600,700,rr.pos.z+2600);c.fov=70;c.updateProjectionMatrix();}
